About.metaDesc: Map-VN — a community-built experience map of Vietnam. Discover real food, cafés, and hidden gems.
About.headline: Vietnam's experience map.
About.intro: {name} is Google Maps for things to do in Vietnam — where locals and international travellers contribute places worth experiencing: eateries, beautiful cafés, bars, rooftops, famous check-in spots, hidden gems, craft villages, workshops…
About.ph1: Map-first — the map is the backbone, not a feed or listing. Explore by geography and theme in parallel.
About.ph2: Community-contributed — content is created by users and reviewed by editors. Always fresh, always local.
About.ph3: Lifestyle > landmarks — focused on real experiences: street-side phở, old-quarter bars, secret rooftops — not hollow photo spots.
About.ph4: Premium yet familiar — Airbnb-grade design paired with Vietnam's flag-red and star-gold.
About.road1: Phase 1 (current) — an MVP demo with mock data plus a community contribution flow, reviews, and a trip planner. Stored in localStorage.
About.road2: Phase 2 — Supabase backend + auth + moderation queue + cross-device sync.
About.road3: Phase 3 — 3D building maps, VI/EN bilingual support, realtime updates, and personalised AI suggestions.

Help.metaDesc: Frequently asked questions about Map-VN — how to use, contribute, account.
Help.title: Help
Help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions about using Map-VN.
Help.q1: How do I save favourite places?
Help.a1: Tap the heart ♡ on any place card (on the map, the landing page, or a detail page). View your saved list at <saved>/saved</saved>.
Help.q2: How do I create a trip?
Help.a2: Go to <trip>Trips</trip> → tap "Create trip". Name it, pick the number of days, and choose destinations (one or several provinces). Then add places to each day — via search or by tapping "Add from map" to pick directly on the map.
Help.q3: How do I contribute a place to the community?
Help.a3: Two ways: (1) go to <submit>/submit</submit> and fill in the form, or (2) on the <explore>map</explore>, tap "Contribute here" then click a spot on the map — the coordinates and province fill in automatically.
Help.q4: Is my review public right away?
Help.a4: In the current beta, your review goes public immediately after you submit it (it uses a localStorage demo). In Phase 2, with a real backend, reviews will go through 24–72h moderation.
Help.a5: Right now everything (saved, trips, reviews, submissions) is stored in this browser's localStorage — it doesn't sync across devices. Phase 2 will wire up a Supabase backend.
Help.q6: Why do some places show on the map but not in a category?
Help.a6: All Phase 1 demo data has only ~40 places across Vietnam — it's not complete yet. Phase 2 will have thousands of real community-contributed places.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.s1Body: In the Phase 1 beta, Map-VN does not send any data to a server. Everything you create (saved, trips, reviews, submissions) is stored in your browser's localStorage — it never leaves your device.
Privacy.s2Body: When you tap "My location" or "GPS" in the contribution form, your browser asks for location permission. Coordinates are used instantly to fly the map and are not stored anywhere.
Privacy.s3Body: Map tiles are fetched from CartoCDN (basemaps.cartocdn.com) — a third-party partner with its own privacy policy. Map-VN does not share user identifiers with them.
Privacy.s4Body: When the official backend launches, we will update this policy with clear terms on user account storage, OAuth providers, the moderation queue, and GDPR-equivalent compliance for European users.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: By using Map-VN, you agree to the terms below. The official version will launch with Phase 2 — the current one is a demo framework for the beta community.
Terms.s1Body: When you contribute a place or write a review, you confirm the content is your own, does not infringe third-party copyright, and grant Map-VN permission to display it publicly on the platform. Uploaded photos must be taken by you or used with permission.
Terms.ban3: False information about places (prices, opening hours…).
Terms.s2Note: Editors reserve the right to remove or reject content that violates these terms.
Terms.s3Body: Map-VN strives to provide accurate information but makes no absolute guarantee — details can change (a venue closes, prices rise, hours change). Please confirm before you visit.
Terms.contactBody: Report violating content, complaints, or questions: <email>hello@map-vn.vn</email>.
